verdict.rationale: Pandoc's primary first-party interface is an official standalone command-line program. It is documented in the MANUAL, with -f/-t flags, stdin/stdout defaults, format discovery via --list-input-formats and --list-output-formats, and Homebrew, Chocolatey and GitHub Actions installs. Community reports of scripted pipelines that generate reports confirm it automates well. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented affordances such as documented machine-readable/structured output or exit-code conventions aimed at AI-driven use.
